summary: Enforce the shared tenant gate, profile-scoped artifacts, mandatory receipts, verified legacy migration, calendar-correct resolved-window and truncation metadata, and typed analytics diagnostics across this participating CLI.
reason: Gate C0 requires every data command to verify the selected client profile before cache or store access, migration to preserve originals and require explicit evidence adoption, and resolved windows to preserve caller form and complete-period intent across daylight-saving transitions.
validated_outcome: Provider-native synthetic migration proves named-account selection, exact account evidence, mandatory receipts, explicit evidence adoption, tenant metadata, path-collision refusal, and recoverable cleanup; focused CLI, platform, output-envelope, receipt byte/delivery/atomic/concurrent-index, and applicable SQLite ownership conformance suites pass; deterministic relative, absolute, complete-month, timezone, daylight-saving, provider-cap, CLI and MCP window conformance is enforced across the fleet; every registered in-process MCP tool is server-middleware gated once per invocation, successful typed-client binding reuses that verified session without a second live probe, and Cobra mirror tools delegate exactly one gate to the bound-profile child CLI; broader release and activation evidence remains part of the PR gate.
